svg.text: 9 // HOVER AND PRESS (INFERRED, NOT SOURCED, EXCEPT FIELD FOCUS)

g.text: hover INFERRED: wash #451010 (#df3131 at .22), stroke + ink #e63132 . press INFERRED: #a52223, ink #59171b, no stroke
NAV CELL . rest / hover / press (the same reading for a LIST ROW and a PRODUCT CARD)
rest SOURCED store #nav62 (153,318): #2e1012, stroke #96282d 1.2, ink #df3131, spine #96282d
hover INFERRED: wash #551719, stroke + spine + ink #df3131 . press INFERRED: #a52223, ink #4a0f10, spine #df3131, height unchanged
hover INFERRED: #f63333 (era rule 8) . press INFERRED: #a52223, ink #420f10 = the Login bar as sampled
rest INFERRED: the focused box with no caret . hover INFERRED: wash #6a1617, stroke #f63333 . press = FOCUS, SOURCED: login field (372.5,602.5) 252x32, #430e0f, stroke #ae2729 1, caret lit
LOGIN BAR SLOT, OBSERVED, not a state
hollow 3.05x19.63 at x 497.33, y 635; sides ~.8, bottom ~.89, #420f10. Static; password caret is separate.
looked at: run-neomil 53..62 and img-06..09 at native scale; no still carries a pointer, no control
differs from its siblings except the transcribed selections. So: hover and press are INFERRED.
HOVER = one rung up: an outlined control takes the store card 2 wash (bright ink at .22 over
its rest fill) and its stroke, spine and ink go bright; a filled control lifts to #f63333.
PRESS = the held red #a52223 with the dark ink on every class (the Login bar's fill, the
darker of the era's two filled reds). Geometry never changes: growth and inversion are selection.

ALL FOUR SCREENS: the same measured12-row ground mesh, blue above and cyan below.
Unobstructed native source patches are pixel-identical across the original screens.
Full-canvas row masks avoid internal joins at fractional render scales.
Login/store use existing source-fit ground; card/nav fields remain separate fidelity work.
Exact fine texture and its authoring recipe remain unknown; no generic noise is added.
See login-store-material.md and dashboard/mailbox material records for holdout evidence.
1 . Cells cut the BOTTOM-LEFT corner (badge 15/57, nav 16/62, list row 12/68);
cards cut the TOP-RIGHT (51 login, 13 store); buttons cut the BOTTOM-RIGHT (9).
2 . Selected controls invert; dashboard T2 keeps bright text on a stronger badge field.
3 . A card or panel that matters carries a bright parallelogram bar on its right
edge with cut ends, and the edge steps 8 to 12 inward below the bar's foot.
4 . A stack of cells hangs a 3px spine off its left edge, stopping at the knee.
5 . Tab rows are the one square-cornered shape and are plainer than the row above.
6 . Micro-text everywhere: a four-line CC35 notice, rotated maker marks in corners
and margins, code tapes with barcode ticks, numbered margin chips (1 left, 2 right).
7 . The store screen has no header row at all; its logotype block replaces it.
8 . No white anywhere: the traces sample none, and dashboard tape/chip faces reach #fb3535.
All four screens use trace-driven scene tables and the same measured ground mesh.
Dashboard is the six-diamond hub; Layout::OpsCharts was removed September 3.
Login portraits/header traced; idle body uses measured two-axis material.
Mailbox lower reader step/corner and source-measured printing/material are transcribed.
Store scatter has 25 cells, pitch 3.6667 and measured per-card origins; echoes stay open.
Source gates test broad inventory, not complete text, artwork or fine texture correctness.
Current evidence: reference-svg-fixes.md and the four screen fidelity/TODO records.
NOT AT FULL EXTENT ON THIS SHEET: the message panel (top-right corner only;
full box 721x387), the scroll rail (210 of 565), the list (3 rows of 8), the nav
(2 rows of 5), the menu (1 diamond of 6). Store card 4, a card cut by the photo
frame at x 1557 with no chamfer and no edge bar, is source geometry omitted from this sheet.
